x-ray.definition: n. X射线，X光；v. 用X光检查
examples: The doctor ordered an X-ray to check my broken arm.
The airport security uses X-ray machines to scan luggage.

xray.definition: n. X射线，X光；v. 用X光检查
examples: Medical xrays help diagnose bone problems.
Xenon is a noble gas used in lighting and imaging.
The display uses xenon gas to produce bright images.
